questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the sixth number is related to the fifth number.

6 : 16 ∷ 20 : ? ∷ 11 : 81
questions.solution:
The logic is :

6 : 16 → 6 : (6 - 2)²

11 : 81 → 11 : (11- 2)²

Similarly,

20 : ? → 20 : (20- 2)²

=> ? = 18² = 324

Hence, ‘324’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: Four words have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner, while one is different. Select the odd word.
questions.solution:
The meaning of the words are :

1) Scream - make a loud, high-pitched sound.

2) Shout - say something very loudly.

3) Mumble - say something indistinctly and quietly, making it difficult for others to hear.

4) Roar - a very loud, deep, prolonged sound made by something inanimate.

All words except ‘mumble’ are synonyms of each other.

Hence, ‘mumble’ is the odd one out.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusion carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which tof the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. Some cars are buses.

2. Some buses are trucks

3. Some trucks are scooters

**Conclusions:**

I. Some cars are scooters.

II. Some trucks are buses.

III. Some scooters are buses.

IV. All scooters are trucks.

options.text: Only conclusions II and IV follow.
Only conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf118bf0d7e84a8620820f49fad82da814bd76f5172c1276c2a93a006a2db2a3.png] 

I. Some cars are scooters. → False (Possible but not Definite)

II. Some trucks are buses. → True

III. Some scooters are buses. → False (Possible but not Definite)

IV. All scooters are trucks. → False (Possible but not Definite)

Hence, only conclusion II follows

Select the option in which the words share the same relationship as that shared by the given pair of words.

questions.solution:
The relation is:

Bacteria : Illness → Bacteria can infect any area of the body. Pneumonia, meningitis, and food poisoning are just a few illnesses that may be caused by harmful bacteria.

The relation is that bacteria causes illness.

1) Painting : Painter → The job of a painter is to paint.

2) Disease : Doctor → A doctor treats different kinds of diseases.

3) Carelessness: Errors → Carelessness results in errors.

4) Appraisal: Performance → For a goof performance, one gets appraisal.

The relation between ‘Bacteria : Illness’, is same as the relation between ‘Carelessness: Errors’.

Hence, ‘Carelessness : Errors’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

Amusing : Hilarious ∷ Moisten : ?
questions.solution:
The relation is:

Amusing - causing laughter and providing entertainment.

Hilarious - extremely amusing.

Amusing and Hilarious are synonyms of each other.

Moisten -to make something slightly wet or to become slightly wet.

1) Soak - make or allow (something) to become thoroughly wet by immersing it in liquid.

2) Dry - free from moisture or liquid; not wet or moist.

3) Humid - marked by a relatively high level of water vapour in the atmosphere.

4) Water - a colourless, transparent, odourless liquid that forms the seas, lakes, rivers, and rain and is the basis of the fluids of living organisms.

The synonym of moisten from the given options is ‘soak’.

Hence, ‘Soak’ is the correct answer.
